tldr: For the entire stated three-state recovery class, the original-record minimax causal stopping regret is comparable, with universal constants, to \(\min\{1,(H\kappa-c)_+,(n\kappa)^{-1/2}\}+\min\{1,(H\kappa-2c)_+,(n\kappa^2)^{-1/2}\}\). The exact zero region is \(H\kappa\leq c\); terminal recovery becomes globally relevant only above \(2c\). One total computable original-record learner attains the all-tuple frontier and the compact-uniform critical value \(G(n\kappa^2,H\kappa)\). The critical transfer learns abundant nuisances from an independent vanishing-fraction original-data pilot in its upper proof and uses the complete likelihood for its all-learner converse. Its sharp rate is \(g_{\mathrm{crit}}(\lambda,h)=\min\{1,(h-2c)_+,\lambda^{-1/2}\}\), with a theoretical arbitrary-error solver returning finite legal rules and rational witnesses. Executed full unknown-hazard numerical certificates and an independent executable checker remain the isolated residual deliverable.
